function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

message.content:
```json
{
  "endpoint": "https://api.startupstats.com/v1/startups",
  "method": "GET",
  "description": "Retrieves a list of startups with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination. Requires an API key passed via the `Authorization` header (`Bearer <API_KEY>`). Supports query parameters:
- `industry` (string): filter by industry sector
- `funding_stage` (string): filter by funding stage (e.g., seed, Series A, Series B)
- `location` (string): filter by city, state, or country
- `min_valuation` (number): minimum valuation in USD
- `max_valuation` (number): maximum valuation in USD
- `search` (string): keyword search on startup name
- `sort_by` (string): field to sort by (`valuation`, `founded_year`, `employees`)
- `order` (string): `asc` or `desc`
- `page` (integer): page number for pagination
- `per_page` (integer): items per page (default 20, max 100)

Returns a JSON payload with `data` (array of startup objects) and `pagination` metadata.

HTTP status codes:
- 200 OK – successful response
- 401 Unauthorized – missing or invalid API key
- 400 Bad Request – invalid query parameters
- 500 Internal Server Error – server-side issue

Rate limit: 1000 requests per hour (free tier). For higher limits, subscribe to a paid plan.

Documentation: https://docs.startupstats.com

Example usage (curl):
```bash
curl -X GET "https://api.startupstats.com/v1/startups?industry=FinTech&funding_stage=Series%20A&page=2&per_page=50" \
     -H "Accept: application/json" \
     -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

Sample response:
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "startup_id": "12345",
      "name": "FinTech Innovators",
      "industry": "FinTech",
      "funding_stage": "Series A",
      "valuation": 120000000,
      "employees": 85,
      "founded_year": 2018,
      "location": "San Francisco, CA, USA",
      "website": "https://fintechinnovators.com",
      "description": "A platform providing AI-driven financial analytics for SMBs."
    },
    {
      "startup_id": "67890",
      "name": "HealthTech Solutions",
      "industry": "HealthTech",
      "funding_stage": "Seed",
      "valuation": 45000000,
      "employees": 30,
      "founded_year": 2020,
      "location": "Boston, MA, USA",
      "website": "https://healthtechsolutions.com",
      "description": "An app that connects patients with telemedicine providers."
    }
  ],
  "pagination": {
    "current_page": 2,
    "per_page": 50,
    "total_pages": 10,
    "total_items": 500
  }
}
```

}
